about: Bila Tserkva: a large city with its own housing market

Bila Tserkva is a large city on the Ros river with its own centre, the Oleksandriia park, panel-block estates, new complexes and a big private sector. Its housing market is self-contained, so requests vary widely, from a cosmetic apartment refresh to a house from scratch.

For business owners in Bila Tserkva we also do [restaurant and café design](/en/restaurant-design), office renovation and [turnkey business premises](/en/business-fit-out), with invoices for companies.

In Bila Tserkva new builds a design project makes the most of the open plan: separate bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, a kitchen-living room. In older buildings — replanning within what is permitted, new services and built-in furniture. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments, houses and commercial premises, from [cosmetic](/en/cosmetic-renovation) to [major renovation](/en/major-renovation). Near Bila Tserkva we build aerated-block, brick, timber-frame and log houses; there is room for a single-storey house with a terrace and a pool, like our House 150. On large sites the crew works in blocks.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
